messages:
laura (support): FYI - we're getting a pile of EU-support tickets reporting streaming disconnects and half-output from SSE clients. Customers: 3 major accounts, lots of reconnect loops.
raj (sre): seeing spike in 10xx and downstream TCP resets on the EU edge LB. Connection counts look normal but some streams drop after ~18-25s.
mina (eng-runtime): could be keepalive or proxy idle timeouts. Any recent config changes to the EU ingress?
tom (eng-oncall): @raj I rolled a config tweak on the nginx proxy last night to change buffer sizes, but no timeout changes. Logs show long-lived connections being proxied via the L7 fleet.
raj (sre): confirmed a small percentage of nginx pods restarted 2h ago due to OOM; might have caused in-flight stream loss and client reconnect loops.
laura (support): customers report partial outputs: the SSE stream emits some tokens then connection drops, clients retry and get duplicate tokens => double billing and confusion. How do we advise them now?
mina (eng-runtime): immediate mitigations: 1) advise clients to enable idempotency / Last-Event-ID handling on reconnects; 2) offer non-streaming fallback (polling chunked responses) for affected accounts; 3) route traffic off the EU region to US for critical customers until we stabilize.
alexa (product): we need a canned status message for status.redwood.ai. Suggested: "Investigating degraded streaming in EU region causing intermittent disconnects and partial outputs. Failover and mitigations in progress." Draft?
laura (support): drafting update now. Also one customer flagged billing spikes because their client retried with full request on reconnect instead of resuming — we should flag billing review.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20250706-312 (EU Streaming Degradation). Priority P1.
raj (sre): quick root cause hypothesis: proxy restart churn + sticky session metadata loss + edge LB health-check flaps -> some clients reconnect to a different backend that didn't have the KV cache for stream state. That can cause truncated outputs.
mina (eng-runtime): runtime note: our streaming SSE endpoint keeps an in-memory cursor and KV cache for partial generation stream. If the upstream process handling the request loses state mid-token (process restart or crash), the client sees partial output then a connection drop.
mina (eng-runtime): short-term engineering mitigations I'm enabling now: - increase proxy keepalive and idle_timeout to 90s - enable sticky session cookie at edge for SSE endpoints - backoff reconnect guidance in response headers - enable Last-Event-ID echo so clients can resume where possible
raj (sre): rolling those changes to a subset of EU edge pods (canary) now. Will monitor for reductions in 10xx and resets.
laura (support): support playbook (for CS reps): 1) ask customer to capture raw SSE stream (curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/stream") and include the last event id. 2) if partial output, switch them temporarily to non-stream endpoint: POST https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate with streaming=false and chunked polling. 3) offer to migrate to us.api.redwood.ai region as emergency fallback.
mina (eng-runtime): add repro snippet for engineering response: ```bash
# reproduce SSE connect
curl -v -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -H "Host: eu.api.redwood.ai" \ 
  "https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-medium&prompt=hello&stream=true"
```
And note: client should check for Last-Event-ID header and send it on reconnect: `Last-Event-ID: <id>` to resume.
raj (sre): telemetry we need from support: raw connection ID, proxy pod name, event-id header, and client library version. That helps correlate with restarts.
mike (customer): we captured logs — attaching the SSE dump now. Stream cut off at token chunk 12/53, then client retried full request and got billed again.
laura (support): told customer we'll credit duplicate tokens if confirm retry amplification caused billing. Filing billing case and note INC reference.
mina (eng-runtime): medium-term fixes: - make stream state persistent across restarts (checkpoint small state to local disk or shared KV) - improve graceful shutdown to finish outstanding stream tokens - make event IDs strictly monotonic and resumable - add server-side retry dedupe for quick reconnects within 2s window.
raj (sre): we observed a correlated increase in TCP RSTs between 17:04-17:28 UTC in eu-west-1. Canary shows a 70% drop in 5xx after patching keepalive, good sign.
tom (eng-oncall): action list I own: 1) monitor for 30m after canary; 2) if stable, roll to all EU edge 3) trigger billing credits for confirmed dup charges 4) update status page with ETA 60m.
alexa (product): please include this wording on status: "Mitigation deployed to subset of edge nodes; streaming success rates improving. Full rollout and validation in progress. Customer-impacting for some long-lived streams; workaround: non-streaming endpoint or US failover."
laura (support): posted status update and CS triage note. Escalating top 3 customers to account execs.
mina (eng-runtime): heads-up: we'll schedule a postmortem once stable. Probable follow-ups: change graceful-shutdown semantics in runtime, add checkpointing for SSE state, and add synthetic streaming tests to CI.
raj (sre): closing loop — if support sees new incidents after full roll, tag me and @tom immediately.
laura (support): thanks all. Final quick checklist for CS replies: 1) collect curl SSE dump + Last-Event-ID, 2) offer migrate/failover, 3) offer manual billing review. I'll keep updating thread as tickets come in.
mina (eng-runtime): one more: recommend clients implement exponential backoff with jitter and dedupe on client side to avoid rapid full replays. Sample header we will emit: `Retry-After: 15000` (ms) for problematic connections.
laura (support): putting a final note on the tickets: incident ref INC-20250706-312, mitigation in progress, ETA 60m.
incident-bot: Updated INC-20250706-312: mitigation applied to canary fleet.
raj (sre): monitoring shows error rate down ~65% in canary, rolling to remaining EU nodes in 8m.
laura (support): ok I'm updating customers and billing team. Will attach playbook steps to each case.
mina (eng-runtime): once full rollout completes I'll open the postmortem doc and share proposed JIRA tasks.
laura (support): thread note end: continuing support escalation channel per-customer. Will update if any regressions.
